author: Clijmart
body:
This is the first map we made at the Map Making Event.
Hope you like it :)

Authors:
Clijmart
Crimson_Aught
DoshCookie_
iHeadTwich

Info:
A map with 2 emerald monuments and a thin core.
Lots of TnT supplies and a few diamonds, spread around the map.
Iron can be blown up with cannons, supply room can't.

Links:
Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/BttMD
Download: Nope
XML: Done by Prodigy4532

Please leave feedback here :D
- Clijmart
